scope: Abstract finite undirected graphs, exact rational affine scores, explicitly bounded polyhedral parameter sets; no biological outcome data
primary_questions: Does enumeration of score arrangement vertices recover all four capacity and barrier extrema?
Do explicit SAT reductions correctly separate possible and guaranteed connectivity when latent dimension varies?
Is unique inclusion minimal vertex path set the exact graph criterion for fixed and adjustable route equivalence under all compact score uncertainties?
arithmetic: fractions.Fraction; no floating arithmetic in production extrema
reference: Separately derived simple path and vertex separator linear programs, with tolerance explicitly identified if using a floating LP solver; fresh reviewer to supply independently authored checks

finite_ranges.graph_classification: all labelled simple graphs on 2 through 5 vertices, distinguished endpoints 0 and n-1, all connected cases
finite_ranges.sat_reduction: all subsets of the eight distinct full three-variable clauses, excluding the empty formula; compare direct Boolean truth tables with constructed graph at the predicted rational witnesses
finite_ranges.affine_cases: bounded deterministic synthetic suite frozen in verifier before execution; no empirical performance optimization

failure_rule: Any exact discrepancy suspends the affected claim and is retained with a minimal counterexample. Narrow or revise the claim before further scale.
nonclaims: finite enumeration is a universal proof
